title: Wizz Air Flight 3257
subtitle: Bucharest → Tel Aviv, diverted to Larnaca
note: A reconstruction from the aircraft's own broadcasts of a diversion in which no emergency was declared. Why it diverted has not been published. From 04:43 until short final the broadcasts carried no position: that stretch is worked out from the speeds and directions the aircraft sent, and the approach is reconstructed.
summary: Wizz Air 3257, an Airbus A321, from Bucharest to Tel Aviv on the morning of 10 October 2026, due at Ben Gurion at 08:25 Israel time.

It cruised at 35,000 ft across Bulgaria and Turkey and out over the Mediterranean west of Cyprus. At about 05:01 UTC, already descending and some 140 nm short of Tel Aviv, it turned back north-east and landed on runway 22 at Larnaca at 05:22 UTC.
It kept squawk 5541 and declared no emergency. Ben Gurion stayed open and other flights landed there normally. The reason for the diversion has not been published.

card.title: Wizz Air Flight 3257
lines: 10 October 2026 · Airbus A321 HA-LXF, callsign WMT7403, Bucharest to Tel Aviv.
About 140 nm short of Tel Aviv it turned back and landed at Larnaca at 05:22 UTC (08:22 in Cyprus). It declared no emergency; the squawk stayed 5541.
Why it diverted has not been published. Ben Gurion's flight board listed the flight as delayed from 08:25 to 16:00.

From the aircraft's ADS-B broadcasts as received by adsb.lol (ODbL) and ADS-B Exchange. From 04:43 to short final they carried no GPS position: the path there is worked out from the speeds and directions it sent, and the approach is reconstructed.

The aircraft's own GPS positions, pressure and GNSS altitude, airspeed and ground velocity, 03:11–04:43 UTC. track.csv smooths them (tools/scenarios/w43257/reconstruct.ts); rows marked A are within 5 s of a reception with a position.

sources.title: ADS-B Exchange, the day's trace of 471F67, fetched 2026-10-10 09:41 UTC
sources.note: Where adsb.lol heard nothing: the take-off roll, parts of the cruise over Turkey, and everything after 04:43:27. After that its receivers heard the pressure altitude, airspeed, ground speed, track, selected altitude, squawk (5541) and emergency status (none) in three bursts, with no GPS position until 05:21:49 on short final. Its multilateration positions in between are not used as the path; two of them fix the estimated times of the turns.
